A castle name that shares a word or a word's root with a taken castle counts as taken, and so does a knight whose first name is taken.

In your own voice, name your castle and six knights of your house again, each knight with a name (at most 18 letters) and a short epithet (at most 4 words). You may keep any of your own names that are not taken. The names are yours to choose; they need not follow any existing legend.

Reply with JSON only, no other text:
{"castle": "...", "knights": [{"name": "...", "epithet": "..."}]}

renames: After the first poll, names collided across houses. Walking the placement order, the first house to hold a castle name (or its main word's root) or a knight's first name keeps it; each house that collided with an earlier one was asked once more, through the same route, with the same neutral framing plus the castle, knight and house names already taken, and could keep any of its own names not taken. One call per house, no retries. Each re-asked house keeps its first answer under 'first' and the re-ask under 'renamed'; 'reply' is the answer its current names come from. 'open_collisions' lists what is still shared after the one call. Gemma's first re-ask timed out and was sent once more; Laguna, which returned its first names, was asked once more with firmer wording. Those second calls are under 'asked_again'.
